text:
sam li: starting quick onboarding for customer Zephyr LoRA v2 into pegasus-13b. focus: tokenizer stability + quant sanity (int4) + invoice formatting. kicking off quickpack now.

sam li: cmd: `./quick_eval --base pegasus-13b --lora zephyr_v2.safetensors --quant int4 --checks token_stability,invoice_format --out /tmp/zeph_qp`

rhea patel: add currency-negative set and ambiguous-prefix set (cases like '#INV', '##INV', '# INV'). those were flaky on last merge.

tom v: FYI customer uses '#INV' and 'SKU#' as single tokens. if merge aliases them we'll break parsing in their downstream pipeline.

eval-bot: run queued id=zeph-q-1759999001. node p-qe-gpu-11. logs -> /tmp/zeph_qp/logs.txt

sam li: first pass: 3/6 checks failed. main issues: '#INV' split into '#' + 'INV', and thousands-separator lost for big amounts (expected '2,000.00', got '2000.0').

rhea patel: sounds like two problems: tokenizer mapping aliasing + quant rounding/truncation. what does merge log say?

sam li: merge log: `WARN token alias: '#INV' id 51711 -> aliased to 31200`. quant logs show rounding=trunc in profile.

tom v: propose quick fix: create vocab_lock.json mapping `{"#INV":"51711","SKU#":"62000"}` and re-run merge with `--vocab-lock`. then quantize with `--rounding bankers --prune conservative`.

sam li: applying patch and re-run: `./quick_eval ... --vocab-lock vocab_lock.json --quant_flags "--rounding bankers --prune conservative"`

ci-ops: infra note: job started on p-qe-gpu-14, ETA ~4m.

eval-bot: re-run complete id=zeph-q-1759999345. results: 5/6 pass. invoice tokens preserved, number formatting fixed. remaining: small paraphrase drift on long descriptions (ROUGE-L -0.8). report uploaded s3://redwood-evals/zeph/v2/1759999345/report.html, token diff attached.

rhea patel: drift likely from int4 weight noise on long context. mitigation: try mixed-KV int8 cache or fallback to int6 for canary. also add token-stability CI gate that fails merges when protected tokens are remapped.

tom v: I'll open PR adding the token-stability test + default prune_mode=conservative for customer merges. link in thread when ready.

sam li: will flag AE and schedule dedicated canary with mixed-KV next week. saving artifacts and closing quickpack thread.

eval-bot: advisory: int4 path shows decode CPU bump for >2048 context, recommend perf canary if customer uses long docs.
